ad_info.reference_style: Bold editorial typographic ad: an oversized, tightly set headline on a flat brand-colored background, with the product as a small sign-off in the corner

global_identity.visual_style: Clean, bold and modern direct-response ad: one flat brand color, one giant condensed headline and the product as a small signature
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Honest, close and a little cheeky: the voice of a friend who has heard the same comment at every family gathering. Confident, never body-shaming
global_identity.graphic_language: Flat deep navy (#1C305F) color field, white type, a single mustard-yellow (#C0B116) key word, generous margins, nothing decorative

creative_objective: Stop the scroll with a sentence every slim woman in Colombia has lived: everybody has an opinion about her body. The statement creates instant identification without pointing at the viewer, and the small support line connects it to the daily ritual of drops that she does her own way.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The giant headline, read as one solid block of type that dominates the canvas. 2) The single highlighted key word OPINA. 3) The small product in the bottom-right corner. 4) The short support line at the bottom left.
art_direction.composition_style: Left-aligned, top-weighted typographic composition. The headline block runs from the 7% top margin down to about 66-68% of the canvas height and spans about 86% of the width (from 7% to 93%), set in 4 stacked lines, so the type mass fills roughly two thirds of the canvas. Below it, a footer zone from about 72% to 93% of the height: support line on the left, product on the right, both bottom-aligned at about 93%.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Safe margins of about 7% on every side. Tight line spacing in the headline so the lines read as one block. A clear gap of about 4-5% of the canvas height between the last headline line and the top of the footer zone. Nothing else on the canvas; the empty background is part of the design.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat graphic design. The background is solid deep navy with at most a barely visible paper grain. The only depth is on the product: soft studio light, a crisp contact shadow and a faint drop shadow so it sits on the flat color like a real object.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas with a flat deep navy background. A huge left-aligned white headline in 4 stacked lines fills the top and middle of the canvas (from the 7% top margin to about 67% of the height, edge to edge between the side margins), with the last word highlighted in mustard yellow. In the bottom footer zone (about 72-93% of the height): a short support text at the bottom left and the product, small (about 20% of the canvas height), standing in the bottom-right corner with a soft shadow. No other elements.

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Solid deep navy #1C305F with at most a barely visible grain. No photos, no patterns, no multi-color gradients.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Top-left, from the 7% top margin down to about 66-68% of the height, spanning about 86% of the width
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: The scroll-stopper itself: the statement is the visual
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Four stacked lines of huge white Anton type that fill the block edge to edge, broken by meaning: A LA FLACA / TODO EL / MUNDO LE / OPINA.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Inside the headline, on its last line
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Directs the eye to the word that carries the emotion of the angle
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Only the word OPINA (with its period) is recolored in mustard yellow #C0B116. Nothing else is highlighted.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Bottom-left footer zone, aligned with the headline's left edge, its last line ending at about 91-93% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Connects the statement to the product in a quiet second read
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: One short sentence in 2 lines, in white handwritten Caveat, within the left 50% of the canvas so it never touches the product.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Signs off the statement and shows what is being sold without competing with the type

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 static ad, bold editorial typographic design. BACKGROUND: one flat, solid deep navy color (#1C305F) across the full canvas, with at most a barely visible paper grain; no photos, no patterns, no gradients. HEADLINE: a huge left-aligned headline in a thick condensed ultra-bold sans-serif (Anton), uppercase, pure white, set in four tightly stacked lines that start at the 7% top margin and end at about 67% of the canvas height, spanning from 7% to 93% of the width, so the type mass fills about two thirds of the canvas and reads as one solid block. The lines break by meaning, one punch per line. Only the last word of the headline, on the fourth line, is recolored in mustard yellow (#C0B116); everything else in the headline is white. FOOTER ZONE (about 72% to 93% of the height), separated from the headline by a clear empty gap of about 4-5% of the height: at the bottom left, aligned with the headline's left edge and kept within the left half of the canvas, a short two-line support sentence in white in a friendly handwritten font (Caveat, bold), its last line ending at about 92% of the height. At the bottom right, inside the margin, the product stands upright, front view, small, about 20% of the canvas height and less than 25% of the width, with its base at about 93% of the height, lit by soft studio light, with a crisp contact shadow and a faint drop shadow so it sits on the flat navy like a real object. The product is the amber glass dropper bottle with a black rubber-bulb dropper cap and a yellow-to-white label shown in the attached product image: use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product and reproduce it exactly as it is, same shape, cap, label, colors and proportions; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. Do not reproduce the yellow circle with the text 60ml from the corner of the product photo. The product never overlaps the headline or the support line. Nothing else on the canvas: the empty navy background is part of the design. No people, no photos, no decorative shapes, no stickers, no arrows, no emojis, no icons, no CTA button, no price, no badges, no stars, no bottom bar, no logos.

text_layers.reference_position: Top-left, from the 7% top margin to about 67% of the height, filling about 86% of the width
text_layers.text_style: Anton, ultra-bold condensed uppercase with tight letter-spacing, huge: each line about 13-14% of the canvas height, 4 stacked lines, left-aligned, pure white on deep navy. Line breaks: A LA FLACA / TODO EL / MUNDO LE / OPINA. The key word OPINA with its final period in mustard yellow #C0B116.
text_layers.text: A LA FLACA TODO EL MUNDO LE OPINA.

text_layers.reference_position: Bottom-left footer zone, aligned with the headline's left edge
text_layers.text_style: Caveat bold, about 4% of the canvas height, 2 lines, left-aligned, max about 50% of the canvas width, white
text_layers.text: Gotas diarias que acompañan tu apetito y tu energía.

mandatory_visual_elements: Giant left-aligned white headline filling 60-70% of the canvas in 4 stacked lines
The single word OPINA highlighted in mustard yellow
The product from the attached photo, small, in the bottom-right corner with a soft contact shadow
final_generation_exclusions: No people, no photos and no lifestyle scene
No yellow 60ml circle copied from the product photo
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts: the headline is a general statement in third person and does not address the viewer's body.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish.
